<?php

$word = rtrim(stream_get_contents(STDIN), "\r\n");

$isValid =
    strlen($word) >= 3 &&
    preg_match('/^[A-Za-z0-9]+$/', $word) === 1 &&
    preg_match('/[aeiou]/i', $word) === 1 &&
    preg_match('/[b-df-hj-np-tv-z]/i', $word) === 1;

echo $isValid ? 'true' : 'false';
?>
